messages:
Asha (People Ops): Hi team 94 quick follow-up from today's All-Hands Q&A thread. Dropping clarifications so managers can share accurate answers during 1:1s.

Maya (SWE): Thanks 94 can you confirm when promotion decisions are final and when we tell folks? Some on my team are juggling offers.

Asha (People Ops): Timeline recap: manager reviews due 2026-04-08, calibration committee meets 2026-04-15, final letters go out 2026-04-22. There will be a 14-day appeals window after letters.

Noah (Eng Manager): If someone appeals and it's approved, does their raise apply retroactively? We had a question about payroll timing.

Liam (Benefits): Retro adjustments: approved changes are backdated to the cycle effective date noted in the committee memo and processed on the payroll immediately following approval.

Maya (SWE): Are equity refreshers tied to promotion decisions or separate? My reports want clarity.

Asha (People Ops): Equity recommendations are part of the promotion packet when appropriate. They're reviewed alongside comp, but managers should explicitly request an equity refresh in calibration notes if they think it's warranted.

Ravi (People Ops): People asked for scripts for managers to use in 1:1s. We're publishing a short manager script + FAQ by 2026-04-18.

Noah (Eng Manager): Also saw confusion about "band" vs "level" during All-Hands. Any quick language we can use?

Asha (People Ops): Use this: "Level describes role scope and expectations (IC levels). Band describes the pay market bucket. You can be at a given level and different points in a band based on comp and tenure." We'll add one-liner examples in the manager packet.

PeopleBot: Reminder: calibration templates due in 6 days for teams on the East region roster. :calendar:·

Maya (SWE): What about market adjustments for counteroffers? Someone asked if we match external offers.

Asha (People Ops): We don't do automatic counteroffers. For retention or market cases, managers should submit a market-adjustment case with evidence (offer letters, market comps). The committee reviews on a rolling basis.

Noah (Eng Manager): Small ops Q: where should we upload calibration docs? I saw two folders referenced in the doc.

Asha (People Ops): Single canonical folder: /handbook/people-ops/calibration/2026-spring. Use the template there. We'll send the exact link in the digest.

Liam (Benefits): Quick note on bonuses: one-time bonuses do not bump someone into a new comp band. Only permanent base increases will affect band placement during calibration.
